title: Head positions on other tapes remain fixed
statement: For every natural number $k$, alphabet $\Gamma$, input word $x$ over $\Gamma$, and work-tape index $i<k$, consider the contract for clearing tape $i$. For every word $w$ and every starting configuration $d$ in the sweep state satisfying the contract's precondition, at every natural-number time $u$ up to and including the contract's prescribed running time, each tape $j\ne i$ has its head at the same position as in $d$.
hypotheses_covered: starting configuration in the sweep state
time $u$ no greater than the prescribed running time
